items.exampleEn: The cold weather killed my flowers.
items.exampleZh: 寒冷的天氣凍死了我的花。

items.exampleEn: Reading is good for your mind.
Can you carry this box for me?
items.exampleZh: 你可以幫我搬這個箱子嗎？
我可以加入你們的隊伍嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Please carry the box with care.

items.audioEn: Do you want to join us? We are watching an action movie.
items.audioZh: 你要加入我們嗎？我們在看動作片。

items.sentenceEn: Be careful. Don't break the cups.
The hot sun killed the grass.
items.sentenceZh: 炎熱的太陽把草曬死了。

items.stemZh: 我可以加入你們的社團嗎？

items.stemEn: My bag is heavy. Can you help me ____ it?
items.stemZh: 我的包包很重，你可以幫我拿嗎？

items.passageEn: Ben wants to join the school drama club. What is on his mind? He wants to be a famous action movie actor! In his first play, he has a small role. He must carry a heavy box on the stage, but he breaks it. Everyone laughs, and Ben laughs too.
items.passageZh: Ben 想加入學校的戲劇社。他心裡在想什麼？他想成為有名的動作片演員！在他的第一齣戲裡，他演一個小角色，要在台上搬一個很重的箱子，結果他把箱子弄壞了。大家都笑了，Ben 也笑了。

referenceEn: Please cut this cake for me.
Can you cut this cake for me?
rubricZh: cut 後面直接接要切的東西（例如 cut this cake）
請求可用 Please…、Can you…? 等

items.instructionZh: 用 join 造一個句子，說說你想參加的社團或活動。
referenceEn: I want to join the swimming club.
rubricZh: join 後面可直接接團體或活動（例如 join the club、join us）；參加活動說 join in the game 也正確
「想參加」可用 want to join、would like to join 等
